The target quantity 21 is a strict integer multiple of the bundle size 7 (21 = 3 \u00d7 7). Under the covering principle for uniform pricing, each bundle of 7 pencils maps deterministically to a $2 cost, and the costs compose additively without remainder or fractional-pricing penalties, producing 3 \u00d7 $2 = $6.","premises":[],"schema":"deepreason-reasoning-envelope-v1","scope":{"covers":[],"excludes":[]},"simulation_refs":[],"uncertainties":[]}
